title: Gottlob Frege, Begriffsschrift, eine der arithmetischen nachgebildete Formelsprache des reinen Denkens (Halle: Nebert, 1879)
edition: The first edition, the RCIN (Repozytorium Cyfrowe Instytutów Naukowych) copy on the Internet Archive; the Archive's text layer

license.payload: Frege (d. 1925) is public domain; the Archive marks the item Public Domain. The text layer does not render the two-dimensional notation; the formulae are held in the scan, by reference. The archive asserts no licence over the payload.
license.record: CC-BY-4.0 applies to this seat record only.

normalization: The Internet Archive's own text layer (_djvu.txt) as served, under original/<identifier>/, copied to text/<slug>.ocr.txt with line endings normalized. The scan is held by reference at its Archive URL and not copied. No text was corrected by hand; the loci keep the OCR's readings.
scope: The book whole, the prose; the notation in the scan.
why_seated: Inference rebuilt from the judgment-stroke out, with one rule of inference; the end of the syllogism as the form of inference.
verified_loci: the preface, on the Bündigkeit of proof — 'meiner Begriffsschrift, wo ein besonderer Werth auf die Bündig' (text/begriffsschrift.ocr.txt)

research.study: Critique of Pure Inference (working draft v1.1) and The Production of Readers (#1767), §11.6 "the witnesses between"
research.for: the reception history of inference from the Peripatos to the machine: the commentators who name Aristotle's ἑταῖροι, the Latin handbooks, the early-modern refusals of the syllogism, the nineteenth-century rebuilds, and the traditions that reasoned about inference without the Organon
